messages:
alex: FYI uploaded the latest assessor bundle from ACME Labs: https://acme.test/report/2026-03-15.zip — can we decide how to slot these findings into a fix tracker?
maria: thanks — quick skim shows 18 findings, ~5 high (auth/priv esc), a couple medium (logging gaps), rest low. I'll start buckets.
jamal: assign me auth/priv esc and I’ll draft mitigation options. estimate 2 sprints for full patch + tests.
lucy: for logging gaps we should map to audit-config PRs, I can push a couple of small policy changes today.
sasha: heads-up: some fixes will need KMS key access for integration tests. we should provision ephemeral tester roles rather than handing long-lived keys.
alex: agree on ephemeral roles. @sre-bot can you create a short-lived role for external assessors scoped to read-only logs and deploy test shim?
sre-bot: created role assessor-ephemeral-2026-03-20 (expires in 48h). Added to docs at /docs/security/assessor-access.md :thumbsup:
maria: for tracking, can we use the new fix-tracker board? columns: triage, owner-assigned, patching, QA, ready-for-retest, closed.
jamal: yes — I added a card for High-1 (priv-esc via token swap). linking details and PoC in the card.
lucy: also adding required audit log evidence for each fix: before/after snippets, log-export command used, and sha256 of config changes.
alex: critical: define retest acceptance criteria per card. example: "PoC no longer works after patch on staging with ephemeral keys, logs show denied action, latency unchanged".
sasha: agreed. for any change touching KMS, we need a KMS-review from infra-keys group and a short rollback plan.
maria: propose SLA for high fixes: owner assigned within 24h, patch within 7 business days, retest window scheduled in next available assessor slot.
jamal: that SLA seems fine. mark blockers early if capacity issues.
alex: who will coordinate retest scheduling with assessors? I can take point but need ownership handoff once bugs are queued.
maria: alex take scheduling. I'll own the fix-tracker orchestration and tagging for compliance exports.
lucy: note for compliance exports: include key usage audit from KMS for the window of testing; export must be redacted and stored in secure bucket.
sasha: and add a step: generate ephemeral API keys for each retest session, with unique session id in the audit logs.
alex: ok — action items: jamal (high fixes + PoC updates), lucy (audit log templates + PRs), maria (board & compliance tags), sasha (ephemeral roles + KMS review), alex (retest scheduling). I'll update the top-level ticket once these are in.
maria: ping me when cards hit ready-for-retest and I'll coordinate compliance export packaging.
jamal: will post short remediation notes as PR descriptions to save auditors time.
alex: thanks all. quick note: if anyone hits blocked-by-SRE, ping @sre-bot with channel #eng-oncall.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a canary run for fix branch jamal/high-1 at 2026-03-21T02:00Z — will post logs to the card.

lucy: small addendum — cryptographic review requested for any key rotation. I'll loop in infra-keys if we rotate.

maria: will set a retest window with assessors for 2026-03-24 to 2026-03-26. please aim to have cards in ready-for-retest by 2026-03-23 EOD. :calendar:

alex: perfect. closing thread for now, we'll reopen when cards move. :white_check_mark:
